user_event_engagement_events.name: user_event_engagement_events
user_event_engagement_events.body_sql:
SELECT
  user_pseudo_id,
  event_date,
  -- extract engagement_time_msec from event_params; NULL if not present
  (SELECT ep.value.int_value
   FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
   WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
   LIMIT 1) AS engagement_time_msec,
  -- carry through keys to preserve requested grain
  event_timestamp,
  event_name,
  event_bundle_sequence_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
  AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
user_event_engagement_events.description: One row per user_engagement event that exposes user identifier, event_date and the engagement time in milliseconds extracted from event_params. Filters to only events with event_name = 'user_engagement' and where an engagement_time_msec param exists (NULL if missing).

user_total_engagement_by_period.name: user_total_engagement_by_period
user_total_engagement_by_period.body_sql:
SELECT
  ue.user_pseudo_id AS user_pseudo_id,
  ue.event_date AS period_bucket,
  SUM(ue.engagement_time_msec) AS total_engagement_msec,
  SUM(ue.engagement_time_msec) / 1000.0 AS total_engagement_seconds
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` AS src,
  UNNEST(src.event_params) AS ep
JOIN
  -- bring through key columns from the raw events; this emulates user_event_engagement_events view rows
  -- filter to event_name = 'user_engagement' and extract engagement_time_msec from event_params.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     event_date,
     CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(epv.string_value, ''), CAST(epv.int_value AS STRING)) AS INT64) AS engagement_time_msec,
     event_timestamp,
     event_name,
     event_bundle_sequence_id
   FROM
     `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` AS e,
     UNNEST(e.event_params) AS ep2,
     UNNEST([ep2.value]) AS epv
   WHERE
     ep2.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
     AND e.event_name = 'user_engagement'
  ) AS ue
ON TRUE
WHERE
  -- restrict shards externally via _TABLE_SUFFIX in the calling query; view itself scans all shards but will be filtered by callers
  TRUE
GROUP BY
  ue.user_pseudo_id,
  ue.event_date
user_total_engagement_by_period.description: Per user_pseudo_id and event_date-period key, sum engagement_time_msec (milliseconds) across that period. This view is intended to be used with a period identifier (e.g., '7d' or '2d') supplied by question_ops via _TABLE_SUFFIX filtering. It exposes raw summed milliseconds and also a derived seconds measure (not aggregated further here).

distinct_users_in_shards.name: distinct_users_in_shards
distinct_users_in_shards.body_sql:
SELECT
  user_pseudo_id,
  event_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
GROUP BY
  user_pseudo_id,
  event_date
distinct_users_in_shards.description: List of distinct user_pseudo_id values observed in the selected shard range (useful for cohort operations where users with no matching events in a narrower event filter still need to be considered). One row per user_pseudo_id per shard date. Caller supplies the _TABLE_SUFFIX range.

sessions_with_product_hits.name: sessions_with_product_hits
sessions_with_product_hits.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  date,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  p_index AS product_index,
  p.v2ProductName AS v2ProductName,
  COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 0) AS productQuantity
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p WITH OFFSET AS p_index
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
sessions_with_product_hits.description: One row per session-hit-product occurrence: explode hits[].product[] so each row represents a product instance observed in a particular session hit (keeps product-level fields and session identifiers). This is a session-level cohort row set useful to filter sessions by products seen/purchased and to aggregate product quantities by session or visitor.

visitors_who_bought_product.name: visitors_who_bought_product
visitors_who_bought_product.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.fullVisitorId AS fullVisitorId,
  MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date)) AS first_seen_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit,
  UNNEST(hit.product) AS product
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
  AND product.v2ProductName = @product_name
GROUP BY
  s.fullVisitorId
visitors_who_bought_product.description: Cohort of visitors (fullVisitorId) who in the given date-shard range had at least one session/hit/product with the specified product name. This view is a reusable visitor-level cohort created by applying a product-name filter on exploded product rows.

sessions_hits_products_flat.name: sessions_hits_products_flat
sessions_hits_products_flat.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  date,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX,
  trafficSource.source AS trafficSource_source,
  hit.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  prod.productSKU AS productSKU,
  prod.productRevenue AS productRevenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS hit,
  UNNEST(hit.product) AS prod
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
sessions_hits_products_flat.description: Explode sessions -> hits -> products into one row per product instance with session-level and hit-level dimensions preserved. Keeps raw productRevenue and trafficSource.source so downstream aggregations can compute totals per day/week/month and per traffic source.

product_revenue_by_source_month.name: product_revenue_by_source_month
product_revenue_by_source_month.body_sql:
SELECT
  trafficSource.source AS trafficSource_source,
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(visitStartTime)) AS month,
  SUM(
    -- product revenue can be at hit.item.productRevenue or hit.transaction.transactionRevenue or hit.item.localItemRevenue etc.
    -- Use hits[].product[].productRevenue when present; fallback to hits[].transaction.transactionRevenue; treat NULL as 0.
    IFNULL(prod.productRevenue, 0) + IFNULL(hit.transaction.transactionRevenue, 0)
  ) AS month_product_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit,
  UNNEST(hit.product) AS prod
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
GROUP BY
  trafficSource.source,
  month
product_revenue_by_source_month.description: Calendar-month aggregated product revenue per traffic source. Sums daily/product rows into calendar months (YYYY-MM) for each trafficSource.source. One row per (trafficSource.source, month).

sessions_with_product_names_exploded.name: sessions_with_product_names_exploded
sessions_with_product_names_exploded.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.fullVisitorId AS fullVisitorId,
  s.visitId AS visitId,
  s.date AS date,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_v2_name,
  p.productSKU AS product_sku,
  -- fallback: prefer v2ProductName, then productSKU, else NULL
  CASE
    WHEN p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL AND p.v2ProductName != '' THEN p.v2ProductName
    WHEN p.productSKU IS NOT NULL AND p.productSKU != '' THEN p.productSKU
    ELSE NULL
  END AS product_name_fallback,
  -- canonical name: prefer v2ProductName, else productSKU; leave NULL if neither
  CASE
    WHEN p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL AND p.v2ProductName != '' THEN p.v2ProductName
    WHEN p.productSKU IS NOT NULL AND p.productSKU != '' THEN p.productSKU
    ELSE NULL
  END AS product_name_canonical,
  COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 0) AS product_quantity
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
sessions_with_product_names_exploded.description: One row per product occurrence within a session hit, exposing session identifiers and canonical product name, SKU, and quantity. Normalizes nested hits->product array into one product-row per product instance for each session/hit.

sessions_with_campaign_cohort.name: sessions_with_campaign_cohort
sessions_with_campaign_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- session identifiers (carry through to keep view joinable)
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  date,
  -- campaign column flattened and aliased exactly as requested
  trafficSource.campaign AS trafficSource_campaign,
  -- include _TABLE_SUFFIX so callers can filter shards easily (optional to material consumers)
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS table_suffix
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  -- leave date/shard filtering to the query that uses this view.
  -- Example shard filter (lifted out of the view):  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
  TRUE
sessions_with_campaign_cohort.description: One row per session (visit) that exposes session identifiers and trafficSource campaign for cohort filtering. Use this to restrict to sessions whose campaign matches a pattern (e.g. contains 'Data Share') and to select date shards.

session_hit_pageviews.name: session_hit_pageviews
session_hit_pageviews.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  date,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  SAFE_CAST(h.time AS INT64) AS hit_time,
  h.page.pagePath AS page_path,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) - 1 AS hit_index_within_session
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
  AND fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL
  AND visitId IS NOT NULL
session_hit_pageviews.description: Explode hits into one row per hit (only pageview-type hits), normalized and casted. Provides hit ordering keys and pagePath and hit time in seconds for intra-session navigation analysis.

session_level_core_metrics.name: session_level_core_metrics
session_level_core_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS shard_table_suffix,
  date,
  SUBSTR(date, 1, 6) AS month,                      -- YYYYMM from date (date is YYYYMMDD string)
  -- canonical visitor id: prefer userId when present, else visitorId coerced to STRING, else fullVisitorId
  COALESCE(NULLIF(userId, ''), CAST(visitorId AS STRING), fullVisitorId) AS visitor_id,
  fullVisitorId AS full_visitor_id,
  visitId,
  -- core totals (keep original names)
  totals.pageviews AS totals_pageviews,
  totals.transactions AS totals_transactions
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  -- ensure we're querying the intended shard range externally via _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN ... in caller;
  -- include only rows that have a date value to preserve grain (sessions are one row per visitId+date)
  date IS NOT NULL
session_level_core_metrics.description: One row per session (session = a row in the wildcard ga_sessions_* shards) with canonical keys and the core metrics needed for session-level classification and month bucketing. Normalizes visitor id choice and extracts YYYY-MM month from date. Filters for sessions with non-null pageviews are left to question_ops (so view is broadly reusable).

sessions_rowlevel.name: sessions_rowlevel
sessions_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  CAST(visitId AS INT64) AS visitId,
  CAST(visitStartTime AS INT64) AS visitStartTime,
  date AS date,
  SAFE_CAST(device.isMobile AS BOOL) AS device_is_mobile,
  SAFE_CAST(totals.visits AS INT64) AS totals_visits,
  SAFE_CAST(totals.pageviews AS INT64) AS totals_pageviews,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS _table_suffix  -- keep shard suffix for traceability (can be ignored by consumers)
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  -- caller should filter the date-range via _TABLE_SUFFIX (lifted out of the view)
  TRUE
sessions_rowlevel.description: One row per session (raw session-level data). Exposes session identifiers, session date, visitor ids, device mobile flag, and session-level totals to support per-user chronology and session-based filters.

transactions_rowlevel.name: transactions_rowlevel
transactions_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  date,
  h.transaction.transactionId AS transactionId,
  COALESCE(device.isMobile, FALSE) AS device_is_mobile
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
  AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
transactions_rowlevel.description: One row per transaction event occurrence (derived by unnesting hits and selecting hits with transaction info). Exposes the session date that contained the transaction, visitor id, transaction id, and the device mobile flag of the containing session. Use to compute first transaction date per user and to check device type at transaction time.

session_hit_product_rows.name: session_hit_product_rows
session_hit_product_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- session identifiers (keep joinable keys)
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  date,
  -- derive month from session date (expected format YYYYMMDD) as YYYY-MM
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) AS month,
  -- hit-level identifier carried through
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  -- hit-level eCommerce action type (may be NULL)
  h.eCommerceAction.action_type AS hits_eCommerceAction_action_type,
  -- product-level fields (one row per product within a hit)
  IFNULL(p.isImpression, FALSE) AS product_isImpression,
  p.productSKU AS product_productSKU,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_v2ProductName,
  p.v2ProductCategory AS product_productCategory,
  p.productQuantity AS product_productQuantity,
  p.productRevenue AS product_productRevenue,
  p.productPrice AS product_productPrice
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  -- restrict to the dataset's full shard range when querying the view;
  -- lift specific date range filters out of the view (user will supply BETWEEN _TABLE_SUFFIX)
  TRUE

semantic_filters._TABLE_SUFFIX: ANY (use question_ops to restrict date range)

session_hit_product_rows.description: One row per product instance within a hit (explodes hits.product array). Keeps hit-, session-, and product-level attributes necessary to classify product-detail views, add-to-cart, and purchases, and to derive month from session date.

hit_level_ecommerce_actions.name: hit_level_ecommerce_actions
hit_level_ecommerce_actions.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  date,
  -- month lifted out of the view: user should filter/compute month externally if needed; here we derive month from date for convenience
  SAFE.SUBSTR(date, 1, 6) AS month,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber,
  -- expose raw eCommerceAction.action_type at hit level (string or NULL)
  h.eCommerceAction.action_type AS hits_eCommerceAction_action_type,
  -- count of products on the hit (0 if NULL)
  ARRAY_LENGTH(h.product) AS hit_product_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE
  -- require the caller to restrict shards by _TABLE_SUFFIX as needed, e.g.
  -- WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  TRUE

semantic_filters._TABLE_SUFFIX: ANY (use question_ops to restrict date range)

hit_level_ecommerce_actions.description: One row per session hit (hit-level) normalized with relevant flags and month. Exposes whether the hit is a product-detail view (eCommerceAction.action_type='2') and the raw eCommerceAction.action_type. Also includes counts of product array length for use in aggregations.

monthly_product_action_counts.name: monthly_product_action_counts
monthly_product_action_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX), MONTH) AS month,
  SUM(
    -- count product rows on hits where eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' (product detail views)
    ARRAY_LENGTH(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
        WHERE SAFE_CAST(h.eCommerceAction.action_type AS STRING) = '2'
        AND h.product IS NOT NULL
        AND ARRAY_LENGTH(h.product) > 0
      )
    )
  ) AS product_detail_product_rows,
  SUM(
    -- count product rows on hits where eCommerceAction.action_type = '3' (add-to-cart)
    ARRAY_LENGTH(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
        WHERE SAFE_CAST(h.eCommerceAction.action_type AS STRING) = '3'
        AND h.product IS NOT NULL
        AND ARRAY_LENGTH(h.product) > 0
      )
    )
  ) AS add_to_cart_product_rows,
  SUM(
    -- count product rows on hits where eCommerceAction.action_type = '6' (purchase)
    ARRAY_LENGTH(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
        WHERE SAFE_CAST(h.eCommerceAction.action_type AS STRING) = '6'
        AND h.product IS NOT NULL
        AND ARRAY_LENGTH(h.product) > 0
      )
    )
  ) AS purchase_product_rows
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

semantic_filters._TABLE_SUFFIX: ANY (use question_ops to restrict to specific date range/months)

monthly_product_action_counts.description: Aggregate counts of product-detail pageviews (by counting product rows on hits with action_type='2') and product action counts (add-to-cart action_type='3' and purchase action_type='6'), grouped by month. Leaves counts raw for final rate calculations.

visitors_first_visit_date.name: visitors_first_visit_date
visitors_first_visit_date.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(visitorId AS STRING) AS visitorId,
  MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
GROUP BY
  visitorId
visitors_first_visit_date.description: One row per visitorId with that visitor's first (minimum) recorded visit date across the sharded ga_sessions_* tables in the queried range.

visitors_first_transaction_date_and_rows.name: visitors_first_transaction_date_and_rows
visitors_first_transaction_date_and_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(visitorId AS STRING) AS visitorId,
  -- earliest date (string in YYYYMMDD) where this visitor had a transaction
  MIN(date) AS first_transaction_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s
LEFT JOIN
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
  -- transaction present either at session totals or on any hit.transaction.transactionId
  AND (
    (s.totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND s.totals.transactions > 0)
    OR (h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL AND h.transaction.transactionId != '')
  )
GROUP BY
  visitorId
visitors_first_transaction_date_and_rows.description: One row per visitorId giving the earliest date where the visitor has a transaction (based on hits[].transaction.transactionId present/non-empty OR totals.transactions > 0) and exposing that transaction_date. This view is at visitorId grain and does not assume device; it can be joined back to session rows on visitorId+date to inspect device fields on the session(s) that contain the first transaction date.

sessions_canonicalized.name: sessions_canonicalized
sessions_canonicalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical_user_id: prefer userId when present, else fullVisitorId when present, else NULL
  CASE
    WHEN userId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(userId) != '' THEN userId
    WHEN fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fullVisitorId) != '' THEN fullVisitorId
    ELSE NULL
  END AS canonical_user_id,

  -- keep original fullVisitorId (normalize empty string to NULL)
  CASE WHEN fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fullVisitorId) != '' THEN fullVisitorId ELSE NULL END AS fullVisitorId,

  -- keep visitorId as INT64 but treat 0 or NULL or empty as NULL
  CASE
    WHEN visitorId IS NOT NULL AND visitorId != 0 THEN visitorId
    ELSE NULL
  END AS visitorId,

  visitId,
  visitStartTime,

  -- parse date string (YYYYMMDD) to ISO date STRING to make it easier to use downstream
  -- Lifted literal: input date format assumed 'YYYYMMDD' as in GA sample
  SAFE_CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTR(date,1,4), "-", SUBSTR(date,5,2), "-", SUBSTR(date,7,2)) AS DATE) AS date,

  -- core totals fields (flattened)
  totals.timeOnSite AS totals_timeOnSite,
  totals.transactions AS totals_transactions,

  -- flag if any hit contains a transaction (either hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL OR hit.transaction.transactionRevenue > 0)
  -- use EXISTS over UNNEST(hits)
  EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
    WHERE
      (h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(h.transaction.transactionId) != '')
      OR (h.transaction.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL AND h.transaction.transactionRevenue != 0)
      OR (h.item IS NOT NULL AND (h.item.transactionId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(h.item.transactionId AS STRING)) != ''))
  ) AS has_hit_transaction
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  -- required: query across shards; lift date range literal out of view (users of view should filter _TABLE_SUFFIX themselves)
  TRUE
sessions_canonicalized.description: One row per raw session (visit) with normalized user id, parsed date, core session measures (visitStartTime, totals.timeOnSite, totals.transactions) and flags for presence of any transaction present in hits. Normalizes empty/NULL fullVisitorId / visitorId to NULL and exposes a single canonical_user_id to use for joining sessions of the same user.

inpatient_charges_2014_rowlevel.name: inpatient_charges_2014_rowlevel
inpatient_charges_2014_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  provider_city,
  provider_state,
  drg_definition,
  total_discharges,
  average_total_payments
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  AND total_discharges IS NOT NULL
  AND average_total_payments IS NOT NULL
inpatient_charges_2014_rowlevel.description: Row-level cohort of inpatient charges restricted to the 2014 shard with non-null discharges and non-null average_total_payments. Keeps original provider and DRG columns for downstream grouping and weighting.

drg_total_discharges_2014.name: drg_total_discharges_2014
drg_total_discharges_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS drg_total_discharges
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
GROUP BY
  drg_definition
drg_total_discharges_2014.description: Aggregated totals of total_discharges per drg_definition for 2014. One row per drg_definition with the sum of total_discharges across providers in 2014.

drg_city_discharge_and_payment_2014.name: drg_city_discharge_and_payment_2014
drg_city_discharge_and_payment_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  ic.drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  ic.provider_city AS provider_city,
  SUM(ic.total_discharges) AS city_total_discharges,
  SUM(ic.average_total_payments * ic.total_discharges) AS city_sum_weighted_total_payments
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*` AS ic
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
GROUP BY
  ic.drg_definition,
  ic.provider_city
drg_city_discharge_and_payment_2014.description: Per-drg_definition × provider_city aggregates for 2014: sums of total_discharges and the sum of (average_total_payments * total_discharges) to allow computing weighted average payments by city for each DRG.

drug_exposures_2014_cohort.name: drug_exposures_2014_cohort
drug_exposures_2014_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.drug_exposure_id,
  de.person_id,
  de.drug_concept_id,
  de.drug_exposure_start_date,
  de.drug_exposure_end_date,
  de.visit_occurrence_id,
  de.provider_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` AS de
WHERE
  -- lift year filter out as a parameter when creating the view; default here selects 2014 calendar year
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_exposure_start_date) = 2014
drug_exposures_2014_cohort.description: Row-level cohort of drug_exposure records filtered to a calendar year range (parameterizable). Exposes primary identifiers and raw date and concept fields needed for grouping and joins to person/location/concept.

person_location_dim.name: person_location_dim
person_location_dim.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  p.location_id AS location_id,
  l.state AS state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.location` AS l
ON

inpatient_row_costs.name: inpatient_row_costs
inpatient_row_costs.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  drg_definition,
  hospital_referral_region_description,
  -- keep total_discharges as integer; if null/negative treat as NULL
  NULLIF(CASE WHEN total_discharges IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN SAFE_CAST(total_discharges AS INT64) < 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE SAFE_CAST(total_discharges AS INT64) END, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS total_discharges,
  -- cleaned numeric: treat negative/NaN as NULL, keep as FLOAT64
  NULLIF(
    CASE
      WHEN average_medicare_payments IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN NOT SAFE_CAST(average_medicare_payments AS FLOAT64) IS NULL THEN
        CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_medicare_payments AS FLOAT64) < 0 THEN NULL ELSE SAFE_CAST(average_medicare_payments AS FLOAT64) END
      ELSE NULL
    END, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)
  ) AS average_medicare_payments,
  -- compute inpatient_row_medicare_cost = total_discharges * average_medicare_payments
  -- Use SAFE_CASTs and NULL propagation: if either is NULL result is NULL
  (CASE
     WHEN total_discharges IS NULL THEN NULL
     WHEN average_medicare_payments IS NULL THEN NULL
     ELSE SAFE_CAST(total_discharges AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(average_medicare_payments AS FLOAT64)
   END) AS inpatient_row_medicare_cost,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
inpatient_row_costs.description: One row per inpatient_charges record with a computed per-row inpatient Medicare cost and cleaned/null-filtered numeric fields.

outpatient_row_costs.name: outpatient_row_costs
outpatient_row_costs.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  apc,
  hospital_referral_region,
  -- keep original count but null-filter to treat non-positive as NULL
  NULLIF(outpatient_services, 0) AS outpatient_services,
  -- ensure average_total_payments is numeric and non-negative; treat non-positive/NULL as NULL
  CASE
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) <= 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64)
  END AS average_total_payments,
  -- outpatient_row_cost = cleaned average_total_payments / outpatient_services when both present
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(outpatient_services, 0) IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN CASE
           WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) <= 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64)
         END IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      (CASE
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) <= 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64)
       END) / CAST(outpatient_services AS FLOAT64)
  END AS outpatient_row_cost,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  -- restrict to the supported shards 2011-2015; lift specific range out of view if caller needs different range
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
outpatient_row_costs.description: One row per outpatient_charges record with a computed per-row outpatient cost and cleaned/null-filtered numeric fields.

icd10_root_standard_concepts.name: icd10_root_standard_concepts
icd10_root_standard_concepts.body_sql:
SELECT
  concept_id,
  concept_name,
  vocabulary_id,
  concept_code,
  standard_concept,
  domain_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept`
WHERE
  -- restrict to ICD-10-CM vocabularies; lift specific vocabulary list out of the view (use as parameter when querying the view)
  vocabulary_id IN ('ICD10CM', 'ICD10CM2019', 'ICD10CM2020', 'ICD10CM2021', 'ICD10CM2022')
  -- root ICD-10-CM codes are those without a dot and typically short (e.g., 'L20', 'L40'); keep codes with length 3 (or length <= 4 without dot)
  AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(concept_code, r'^[A-Z][0-9]{2}$')
  -- ensure domain is appropriate (clinical/condition domain usually), but keep as provided so downstream can filter if needed
  -- keep both standard and non-standard flagged concepts; the standard_concept column indicates standard status
icd10_root_standard_concepts.description: Rows for ICD-10-CM root concepts (e.g., codes like 'L20', 'L40', etc.) from the concept table restricted to ICD-10-CM vocabularies and flagged with whether they are standard. This isolates candidate root concepts to be expanded to descendants later.

stations_basic.name: stations_basic
stations_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.usaf AS usaf,
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.wban AS wban,
  TRIM(NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.name, '')) AS name,
  NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.country, '') AS country,
  NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.state, '') AS state,
  NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.call, '') AS call,
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.lat AS lat,
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.lon AS lon,
  NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.elev, '') AS elev,
  -- parse begin and end strings to DATE where possible; keep NULL when unparsable or empty
  CASE
    WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.begin, '')) IS NOT NULL
      THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.begin, ''))
    WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.begin, '')) IS NOT NULL
      THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.begin, ''))
    WHEN NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.begin, '') IS NOT NULL
      THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.begin, ''))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS begin_date,
  CASE
    WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.`end`, '')) IS NOT NULL
      THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.`end`, ''))
    WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.`end`, '')) IS NOT NULL
      THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.`end`, ''))
    WHEN NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.`end`, '') IS NOT NULL
      THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y', NULLIF(`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.`end`, ''))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS end_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
stations_basic.description: Canonicalized station metadata/identifiers and parsed begin/end dates for each station record.

WHERE

  -- Keep stations that began on or before the requested interval start and ended on or after the requested interval end.
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.begin) <= @interval_start
  AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.`end`) >= @interval_end

gsod_daily_station_normalized.name: gsod_daily_station_normalized
gsod_daily_station_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn,
  -- build ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD from year,mo,da (pad month/day to 2 digits)
  CONCAT(year, '-', LPAD(mo, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(da, 2, '0')) AS iso_date,
  year,
  mo,
  da,
  -- temp: sentinel 9999.9 -> NULL, otherwise keep numeric as temp_f
  NULLIF(NULLIF(temp, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) AS temp_f,
  -- wdsp is stored as STRING in this dataset; cast to FLOAT64 when possible,
  -- treat string/numeric sentinel "999.9" / 999.9 as NULL
  (
    CASE
      WHEN wdsp IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN wdsp IN ('999.9', '9999.9') THEN NULL
      ELSE
        SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)
    END
  ) AS wdsp_kt,
  -- precipitation: sentinel 99.99 -> NULL, otherwise keep numeric as prcp_in
  CASE
    WHEN prcp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN prcp = 99.99 THEN NULL
    ELSE prcp
  END AS prcp_in
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
gsod_daily_station_normalized.description: Cleans and canonicalizes temperature, wind speed, and precipitation values from daily gsod rows: casts wdsp to numeric when stored as STRING, converts sentinel missing values to NULL (temp=9999.9 -> NULL, wdsp in ("999.9","999.9" numeric) -> NULL, prcp=99.99 -> NULL). Keeps one row per station-date and exposes an ISO date string. This view does not aggregate across days.
